verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for a Git client with automation features, but the evidence documents no time-based or recurring scheduler. Auto-Sync and Background Sync run when changes are detected, not on a recurring schedule. Shortcuts and x-callback-url support is integration with the host platform, and the evidence never says Working Copy itself can schedule anything.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
